actual_scope: Exact joint entry-degree and right-vector paid-cost count for GL2(F_q[t]); cost minus one is Binomial(D-1,(q-1)/q) at every exact degree D>=1.
scope_change_reason: The connector card is changed to a formal-alphabet counting side result building on the binary polynomial cost theorem #4763. The coefficient field and degree are now arbitrary. This supplies an exact distribution, not a new source-toggle construction or a re-audit of the binary census.
bottleneck_link: Quantifies typical and extremal cost in a formal coefficient algebra where the universal bounded-cost abstraction fails. No native supplier bill or multiplication saving follows.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified exact distribution; package it without extending to other coefficient algebras or sampling measures.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the quantified all-q joint count and binomial law. verify.py matches all 63504 independently enumerated targets over F2,F3,F4,F5, checks 924 invertible paid parameter tuples, 480 exact probability cases and eight control groups.
